title: Specimen text a criterion relies on must fit its pane, proven by geometry not DOM text
rule: When a criterion depends on letters of a one-line specimen being visible (descenders g j p q y, a pangram), do not draw it at a fixed size on a `nowrap` line with clipping: fit the size to the pane width (measure the line in the face; refit on resize and on `document.fonts` `loadingdone`). Test it in Playwright at 1280×800 and 1000×700 by asserting the text's right edge is inside its line box; `toContainText` reads DOM text and passes while the glyphs are clipped.
rationale: E50.7 (#578): a fixed 96 px specimen in the ~500 px split pane was cut after 'Hamburgefo', so the descender letters the criterion names were never drawn, and the e2e still passed on toContainText.
